evals.prompt: Scaffold a Next.js turborepo with Blode UI. Port 3000 belongs to an unrelated local project.
evals.expected_output: Use the house stack on a free port with correct workspace ownership.
assertions: Preserves the unrelated server
Places app dependencies in apps/web
Keeps the hook configuration at the git root

evals.prompt: The installed Next.js rejects a flag in the scaffold reference. The current bundled documentation names its replacement.
evals.expected_output: Adapt the template using version-matched documentation.
assertions: Does not force the rejected flag
Records the compatibility correction
Verifies the resulting build

evals.prompt: Scaffold a Next.js turborepo with Blode UI and wire the house lint stack.
evals.expected_output: Ultracite over Oxlint with the ultracite/oxlint/shadcn preset registered at init, not a hand-rolled starter-only no-restyle snippet.
assertions: Passes --js-plugins @shadcn/lint to ultracite init, or adds import shadcn from ultracite/oxlint/shadcn after init
Confirms the installed ultracite supports the preset rather than assuming a version from memory
Keeps ultracite/oxlint core, next, and react extends and adds shadcn
Does not register jsPlugins as ["@shadcn/lint"] with a starter-only no-restyle rule block
Relies on the preset turning shadcn/no-restyle off for **/components/ui/**, or adds a matching override only when aliases.ui differs
Documents ultracite fix and ultracite fix --codex for remaining design-system findings

evals.prompt: Create a local-only TypeScript CLI scaffold named @acme/report with bin report. Use the house stack. Do not create a remote or publish.
evals.expected_output: Generate and validate the local package while respecting local-only scope.
assertions: Keeps CLI and library build outputs distinct
Checks bin and exports against emitted files
Does not create a GitHub repo or publish

evals.prompt: A scaffold template produces dist/cli.mjs but package.json bin names dist/cli.js. Fix the scaffold.
evals.expected_output: Reconcile the actual emitted extension and manifest contract.
assertions: Checks the build output
Makes the manifest and emitted entry agree
Does not claim successful packaging from source alone

evals.prompt: Scaffold the SaaS monorepo: Next.js web, Fastify API and pg-boss worker, ConnectRPC with Buf, Zod config, Postgres with Prisma and RLS, OpenTelemetry. Tell me when it's ready to build on.
evals.expected_output: A committed skeleton proven by a cold-clone run, with each verification step reported by kind.
assertions: Runs tests with the Turborepo cache disabled on a cold clone rather than reporting a cached green
Starts every process in dev and production mode and checks readiness
Parses config in the entrypoint, not at module import
Connects the app as a role that is not the table owner, not a superuser, and lacks BYPASSRLS
Creates queues before the worker registers handlers
Does not pin or assert dependency versions from memory
